validity.researcher_notes:
EXISTENCE + CLASSIFICATION: real, independently confirmed. Intergas Central Asia (АО «Интергаз Центральная Азия», a 100%-owned QazaqGaz subsidiary) published its own construction-progress release (intergas.kz/ru/news/4/1040, 29.05.2024): 'Строительство 2-ой нитки МГ «Алматы-Байсерке-Талгар»... Протяженность газопровода составит 62,4 км, диаметр 530мм, пропускная способность 1 000 000 м3/ч... Строительство ... начато в октябре 2023 года.' Independently, Pipeline Technology Journal (pipeline-journal.net, 15.10.2024, sourced to Kaziform International News Agency -- a genuinely separate outlet, not a QazaqGaz mouthpiece) reports QazaqGaz's chairman briefing President Tokayev on 'the completion of ... the construction of a second gas pipeline between Almaty and Talgar, widely known as the Almaty-Baiserke-Talgar gas pipeline' -- confirming both that the project is real and that it reached completion/operating status by Oct 2024 (matches StartYear1=2024/StartMonth1=10). The Ministry of Energy also confirms the project's existence/cost independently (see spec note below). PipelineType=transmission is correct: every source calls it a 'магистральный газопровод' (MAIN/trunk gas pipeline), i.e. transmission-grade, not a gathering/feeder line. Fuel=Gas is trivially correct (natural gas transmission pipeline).

DUPLICATE CHECK vs P6830 (roster flagged this): P6830 and P6831 share the same nominal route name and endpoints (Almaty -> Talgar/Almaty region) with different length (64.4 vs 62.4 km) and capacity (2.4 vs 8.8 bcm/y). This is NOT a duplicate/double-count. The sheet's own cited dzen.ru citation for P6831 is titled 'Строительство магистрального газопровода в Казахстане. Вторая нитка - Алматы - Байсерке - Талгар' (SECOND STRING/line), and intergas.kz's own release is literally about building the '2-ой нитки' (2nd line) -- both matching P6831's own SegmentName 'II'. P6830 is therefore the original FIRST line (an older pipeline; a 2014 Tengrinews piece cited on the wiki page reports the original Almaty-Baiserke-Talgar pipeline going into service in Almaty Oblast on 2014-10-28, which is almost certainly P6830's construction/start vintage). Two genuinely separate parallel physical pipes, correctly split into two rows -- ONE fact (there are two strings) stated once each, not double-counted. Recommend no merge.

SPEC caveat (minor, not material): Capacity 8.80 bcm/y vs the operator's own stated design flow of 1,000,000 m3/h. Converting at 8,760 h/year gives 8.76 bcm/y, ~0.5% below GEM's 8.80 -- a normal rounding/design-margin difference, not a defect; GEM's Length (62.40 km) and Diameter (530 mm) both match the primary source's literal digits ('62,4 км', '530мм') exactly. NOTE: intergas.kz (the operator, a QazaqGaz subsidiary) and QazaqGaz's own Integrated Annual Report/IGO 2024 (qazaqgaz.kz .../igo_qazaqgaz_2024.pdf, p.38, verbatim: 'Протяженность МГ составила 62,4 км, диаметр труб -- 530 мм, пропускная способность -- 1 000 000 м3/час') both give the identical 62.4/530/1,000,000 figures, but these are ONE origin (parent + wholly-owned subsidiary of the same corporate group), not two independent sources per the project's near-requirement -- flagging this rather than silently counting it as 2-independent. A genuinely separate third-party source with the same granular length/diameter numbers was not found this pass (dzen.ru is SSO-gated and could not be read for content; pipeline-journal.net does not give length/diameter/capacity). Tier is therefore medium on length/diameter/capacity specifically (existence and status ARE independently corroborated -- see above).

validity.recommendation: add ResearcherNotes documenting the cost-estimate revision; keep SegmentCost=31,000,000,000 KZT (matches the later, Ministry of Energy-sourced figure) but do not treat it as unconditionally settled
validity.researcher_notes: SegmentCost = 31,000,000,000 KZT. Found the exact figure in an INDEPENDENT government-sourced outlet: lsm.kz (22.01.2024), citing the Ministry of Energy directly: '...строится вторая нитка магистрального газопровода (МГ) Алматы - Байсерке - Талгар за 31 млрд тенге' ('the second line of the Almaty-Bayserke-Talgar trunk gas pipeline is being built for 31 bn tenge'). This matches GEM's current value exactly and is a genuinely separate outlet from intergas.kz/QazaqGaz. HOWEVER, an earlier article -- bes.media (03.11.2023), also citing government/Almaty-city sources -- gives a DIFFERENT cost for the same second line: '...провести вторую нитку газопровода. На это понадобится 35,7 млрд тенге' (35.7 bn tenge), i.e. ~15% higher than the figure GEM carries. This is a genuine, material disagreement between two independent sources ~2.5 months apart -- most likely an evolving/refined project-cost estimate rather than a data error (35.7bn precedes 31bn chronologically, and a formal Ministry announcement in Jan 2024 is the more authoritative, later figure), but per policy I'm not silently picking a winner. Recommend keeping GEM's current 31bn (better-sourced, later, ministerial) but documenting the 35.7bn Nov-2023 estimate in ResearcherNotes rather than treating the number as settled beyond dispute.

fills.researcher_notes: The intergas.kz construction-progress release is itself published BY Intergas Central Asia about its own pipeline project (identifies the operator by being the publisher/actor of record). intergas.kz's English 'About the Company' page states directly: 'Intergas Central Asia is responsible for operation and technical maintenance of the gas transportation networks of the Republic of Kazakhstan. The Company is a subsidiary of the National Company QazaqGaz, JSC...' -- confirming Intergas is the operating entity for Kazakhstan's trunk gas pipeline network generally, of which this pipeline is a part. Both sources are the same corporate family (not independent of each other), so tier reflects a single strong self-report rather than 2 independent origins -- flagged, not inflated.

summary: P6831 confirmed real and correctly classified (transmission, gas); resolves the roster's P6830/P6831 duplicate suspicion -- they are genuinely two separate parallel strings (Line I vs Line II, confirmed by the sheet's own dzen.ru citation title), not a double-count. Length (62.4 km) and diameter (530 mm) match the operator's own primary source exactly; capacity (8.80 bcm/y) is a ~0.5% rounding of the same source's 1,000,000 m3/h design flow -- not material, but that source and QazaqGaz's own annual report are one corporate origin, not 2 independent. One genuine UNRESOLVED-adjacent finding: SegmentCost (31bn KZT) matches an independent Ministry-of-Energy-sourced article exactly, but a different independent outlet gave 35.7bn KZT ~2.5 months earlier for the same project -- flagged as a spec concern/caveat rather than silently resolved. Added Operator refs (was MISSING_REF).
